description: This file contains utility functions for various tasks such as input type detection, MIME type mapping, JSON type mapping, skill name generation, input schema creation using Pydantic, port availability checking, and result serialization. It is part of the agent_utils module within a larger SDK, focusing on helper functions for handling different data types, file detection, and schema generation.

classes.name: AgentUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for handling input detection, MIME types, schema creation, port checking, and serialization.

methods.name: str detect_input_type(input_data: Any)
methods.description: Detects the type of input data (e.g., URL, file, bytes, dict, list, etc.) with smart checks.

methods.name: bool is_image_url(url: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL likely points to an image based on its extension.

methods.name: bool is_audio_url(url: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL likely points to an audio file based on its extension.

methods.name: str get_mime_type(extension: str)
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string for a given file extension.

methods.name: Type map_json_type_to_python(json_type: str)
methods.description: Maps JSON schema types to corresponding Python types.

methods.name: str generate_skill_name(server_alias: str, tool_name: str)
methods.description: Creates a sanitized, valid Python function name based on server alias and tool name.

methods.name: Type[BaseModel] create_input_schema_from_mcp_tool( skill_name: str, tool: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Generates a Pydantic input schema model based on an MCP tool's input schema definition.

methods.name: bool is_port_available(port: int)
methods.description: Checks if a network port is available to bind.

methods.name: Any serialize_result(result: Any)
methods.description: Serializes various types of objects into JSON-serializable formats, handling Pydantic models, custom objects, and basic data types.

ctags.name: generate_skill_name
ctags.pattern: /^    def generate_skill_name(server_alias: str, tool_name: str) -> str:$/
